text: Use /init to initialize project guidance in AGENTS.md.
For ponytail, say: "Use ponytail: make the smallest complete change."
For caveman, say: "Be brief" or "caveman mode"; say "normal mode" to stop.
For grilling, ask: "Turn this idea into a spec and clarify the unknowns."
For lean-build, ask: "Implement this feature with these acceptance criteria."
For diagnosing-bugs, ask: "Find the cause of this bug before fixing it."
For code-review, ask: "Review this diff for correctness."
For safe-refactor, ask: "Refactor this code without changing its behavior."
For tdd, ask: "Use test-first development: red, green, refactor."
For verify-and-stop, ask: "Verify this work against the acceptance criteria; don't expand scope."
For codebase-design, ask: "Design module boundaries and interfaces for this service."
For migration, ask: "Implement this migration with compatibility checks and rollback."
For frontend-design, ask: "Design a responsive, accessible web interface."
For webapp-testing, ask: "Test this local web app with Playwright."
For agent-browser, ask: "Open this website and test the signup form with agent-browser."
For ui-ux-pro-max, ask: "Use local UI/UX guidance to choose an accessible palette and typography."
For docx, ask: "Create a Word document with headings and a table of contents."
For pdf, ask: "Extract the text and tables from this PDF."
For xlsx, ask: "Create an Excel spreadsheet with these formulas."
For pptx, ask: "Create a presentation deck from this outline."
For mcp-builder, ask: "Build an MCP server for this API."
For writing-for-agents, ask: "Improve the routing and structure of this AGENTS.md."
For find-skills, ask: "Find an installable skill for this task."
Use /summary for a concise summary of work, decisions, and next steps.
Use /commit to write a commit message from your Git changes; it does not commit them.
Name relevant files, constraints, and expected behavior in your prompt.
Choose Enable if grep/find/ls setup is offered to save your project preference.
Give acceptance criteria when asking for a feature so the agent knows when to stop.
Use /help to discover commands; /sound configures sound notifications.
Use /reload after updating PieXis resources.
UI/UX searches require Python 3; agent-browser requires its CLI and browser binaries installed separately.
In AskQuestion, use arrows to navigate, Space to toggle, Enter to confirm, and Esc to cancel.
In AskQuestion, Tab revisits related questions without losing your drafts.
Footer: the chat bubble counts user messages across the whole session.
Footer: the lightning icon shows the cache-hit percentage for the current branch.
Footer: cost is an estimate, not your provider's billing total.
Context: the bar turns yellow at 70% and red at 90%.
Token and cost totals follow the current conversation branch.
Tips change on startup or reload, not on every screen redraw.
Describe your task naturally; matching available skills can be selected automatically, but selection is not guaranteed.
Say "use the code-review skill" to request a skill by name without a slash command.
Only skills marked disable-model-invocation: true require explicit commands; none bundled here have that flag.
